value.bodyText:
1. Create a dedicated non-admin service account for the MID Server. This account requires the Log on as a Service right and Read, Write, Execute permissions on the MID Server installation folder.
  2. Navigate to \conf\wrapper-override.conf and edit the following:

    ParameterAction
    wrapper.ntservice.accountSet to service account name (DOMAIN\svc_mid_uswest1)
    wrapper.ntservice.password.promptUncomment, no change
    wrapper.ntservice.permissions.1.accountSet to service account name (DOMAIN\svc_mid_uswest1)
    wrapper.ntservice.permissions.1.allowUncomment, no change
    wrapper.nameSet a name for this MID Server. This name must be unique on the host. (mid-uswest-01)

1. Create a dedicated non-root account for the MID Server
  2. Navigate to mid.shconf_override and edit the following:

    ParameterAction
    APP_NAMESet to a unique MID Server Name (mid_centos_1)
    APP_LONG_NAMESet to a unique MID Server Name (ServiceNow MID Server Centos 1)
    RUN_AS_USERSet to non-root username (DOMAIN\svc_mid_uswest1)
    GROUP_NAMEOptional: Add name of group directory to own MID Server folder
    PROMPT_BEFORE_OWNERSHIP_CHANGESet to true
value.title: Configure a Non-Root User (Recommended)

value.bodyText:
1. Navigate to the agent folder and configure the following properties at the top of config.xml with a text editor:

    ParameterAction
    urlSet to your instance URL (https://YOUR_INSTANCE.service-now.com/)
    mid.instance.usernameEnter the name of the MID Server user that you already created. The MID Server user must have the mid_server role.
    mid.instance.passwordEnter the password for the user in the ServiceNow MID Server username.
    nameSet to your MID Server name. This name must be unique and cannot contain spaces or special characters. (mid-uswest-01)
  2. If your MID connects to the instance through a proxy, uncomment and configure the following properties as well:

    ParameterAction
    mid.proxy.use_proxySet to true
    mid.proxy.hostSet to your proxy value (proxy.example.com)
    mid.proxy.portSet to your proxy port (defaults to 8080)
    mid.proxy.passwordOptional, set to your proxy password
